thread:
support_jen: FYI - FinLedger reporting repeated 5xx and timeouts hitting hosted inference since ~14:07 UTC. Customer sees p99 timeouts on generation requests and a bunch of 504s. They attached sample request ids.

customer_relay: request ids: 01F8Z7A2, 01F8Z7C3, 01F8Z7D0 — all 504 from gateway. Trying same payload against a low-traffic tenant returns OK.

sre_tom: Can you paste one of the gateway logs / error lines? Also what model + seq len?

support_jen: Pasted snippet from gateway: 
```
ERROR gateway: upstream timeout after 30s handling request id=01F8Z7A2 tenant=finledger host=hosted-eu-01 route=/v1/generate status=504 queue_depth=128 batch_size=1
```
Model: gpt-neo-2k (continuous-batcher on hosted). Typical seq len 1.4k tokens for these requests.

ingrid_eng: queue_depth=128 looks like we hit the tenant soft-limit. Recent deploy changed default batch_depth -> 128? @maya_ops any scaling/limits changes around 14:00?

maya_ops: We rolled a config tweak at 13:58 to reduce worker memory headroom for the CBatcher to fit more pods. That lowered effective in-flight depth per host. Noticed small uptick in KV miss churn. Rolling back now.

oncall-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-1789 severity=high assignees=sre_tom,ingrid_eng start=1759135900

sre_tom: Observed continuous-batch backlog on host pool hosted-eu-01: batcher backlog = 450 requests, dequeue rate dropped by ~40%. KV cache miss rate spike + CPU per-batcher 90%. Looks like coldpath thrash causing long tail.

support_jen: Customer says they started ramping traffic ~14:05 (bulk payments feature). We likely saw a thinburst then coldpath.

ingrid_eng: Repro steps I'm running: 
1) hit /v1/generate with 1400 token prompt at 50rps for 60s against hosted-eu-01 route
2) observe queue_depth metric and batcher backlog.

Command: 
```
hey -n 300 -c 50 -m POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d @large_prompt.json
```

maya_ops: Quick mitigation: enabled fallback routing policy to use smaller quantized variant (gpt-neo-2k-q4) for the tenant, and increased per-tenant queue cap to 192 for 10m. Apply change -> now.

sre_tom: After fallback, dequeue rate improved ~25% and backlog dropping. But p95 still elevated (~1.2s -> 2.8s). Tail p99 still hitting 30s for some traces where KV cache cold misses chain.

support_jen: Customer is seeing fewer 504s but still some timeouts. They're asking for ETA and whether billing will be impacted.

billing-ops: If we apply fallback to quantized variant that reduces GPU time, usage will be billed as normal per-token; no billing breaks expected. If we throttle/queue-drop, we notify customer about rejected requests.

ingrid_eng: Long term fix notes: 1) revert aggressive memory headroom change; 2) add per-host KV warming during scale-up so coldpath misses don't stack; 3) increase batcher parallelism for high seq length tenants and surface model-variant suggestions in console.

sre_tom: For this incident, recommended actions executed: rollback headroom change (in progress), temporary queue cap bump, fallback to q4 variant, and route some traffic to fallback region hosted-us-02.

support_jen: I communicated to FinLedger: "We've enabled a temporary fallback model and raised your queue cap; this should reduce 504s. Engineering is rolling a rollback and KV warmup. We'll follow up within 60m with status and possible follow-up mitigation." Customer: :thumbsup:

customer_relay: Thanks — seeing much improved success rate. Still a handful of slow responses but acceptable for now. Appreciate the quick action.

oncall-bot: Pager duty alert closed by sre_tom at 1759136142 (acknowledged).

maya_ops: Rollback confirmed applied at 1759136005. Observing KV miss rate returning to baseline in ~90s.

sre_tom: Post-mitigation metrics at 14:18 UTC: backlog -> 48, queue_depth avg -> 42, p95 -> 1.1s, p99 -> 3.2s (down from 30s). Close monitoring for next 2 hours.

support_jen: Final note for incident doc: probable root cause = aggressive memory headroom tuning reduced effective in-flight capacity -> thinburst combined with high seq length requests caused continuous-batcher backlog + KV coldpath thrash -> tail timeouts and 504s. Action items: runbook update to include throttle-on-high-seqlen, automatic KV prewarm on scale events, and console warning when per-tenant queue cap hit >85% for 30s.

ingrid_eng: Filing follow-up ticket in infra backlog with PR link to revert/parametrize headroom change.

support_jen: Closing thread; will attach traces and request ids to the incident ticket.

customer_relay: Thank you all.
